name: What is the difference between warm white and cool white lighting for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between warm white and cool white lighting for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warm white lighting (around 2700K-3000K) has a yellowish hue, similar to incandescent bulbs, creating a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. Cool white lighting (around 4000K-5000K) has a bluer, brighter appearance, often preferred for task-oriented areas as it mimics natural daylight and can make colors appear truer. The choice depends on desired ambiance and function.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warm white (2700K-3000K) is cozy and yellowish; cool white (4000K-5000K) is brighter, bluish, and good for tasks.
